title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Judges 18: the Danites spy out Laish, take Micah's priest and images, and rename the city Dan.

questions.text: In those days, what was the tribe of the Danites seeking?
questions.explanation: Judges 18:1 says the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in, because their inheritance had not yet fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

answers.text: A place to build an altar

questions.text: From which towns did the five Danite spies come?
questions.explanation: The children of Dan sent five men of valor from Zorah and from Eshtaol to spy out the land.

questions.text: Who had hired the young Levite to be his priest?
questions.explanation: The Levite told the spies that Micah had hired him and that he had become his priest.

questions.text: What did the priest tell the five men after they asked him to seek counsel from God?
questions.explanation: The priest said, "Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh."

answers.text: Not to go, for the land was well guarded
To wait seven days and then ask again
To return home to their brothers
To go in peace, for their way was before Yahweh

questions.text: How did the five men see the people of Laish living?
questions.explanation: They saw that the people of Laish lived in safety, quiet and secure, with no one in the land possessing authority.

answers.text: Under a strong and harsh king

questions.text: How many armed men set out from Zorah and Eshtaol?
questions.explanation: The family of the Danites set out with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

questions.text: What did the Danites ask the priest when he questioned them in Micah's house?
questions.explanation: They told him to be a father and a priest to them, asking whether it was better to be priest to one man's house or to a tribe and a family in Israel.

answers.text: To bless the house of Micah
To hide the images from Micah
To go and spy out Laish
To be a father and a priest to them

questions.text: What did Micah do when he saw that the Danites were too strong for him?
questions.explanation: When Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

answers.text: He fought them at the gate
He went back to his house
He sent word to the Sidonians

questions.text: What name did the Danites give to Laish after they rebuilt it?
questions.explanation: They called the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father; the city used to be called Laish.

questions.text: Who served as priest to the tribe of the Danites, along with his sons?
questions.explanation: Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the captivity of the land.
